subtitle: A governed reader atlas for A Song of Ice and Fire

boundary.purpose: navigation, source comparison, burden selection, and review

standing.label: Exact private editions
standing.note: Receipted holder-controlled estate; bytes remain outside the public repository.

standing.label: Receipted words
standing.note: Private-estate standing, not public source text.

standing.label: Paragraph receipts
standing.note: Exact locators retained in the private estate.

standing.label: Semantic candidates
standing.note: Review queue only; no automatic promotion.

standing.label: Sealed continuation components
standing.note: Nine live and nine archive-replay checks pass in the retained delivery.

sourceLanes.name: Exact books
sourceLanes.canEstablish: Edition-specific wording, sequence, narrator, and locator after review.
sourceLanes.cannotEstablish: Public redistribution or automatic proposition admission.

sourceLanes.name: Released future material
sourceLanes.canEstablish: What a specific preview, reading, app release, or excerpt exposed at a recorded time.
sourceLanes.cannotEstablish: Final Winds wording, order, or inclusion.

sourceLanes.name: Author statements
sourceLanes.canEstablish: What Martin said, when, where, and with what recording quality.
sourceLanes.cannotEstablish: Unqualified fictional fact when the statement is hedged, recalled, or superseded.

sourceLanes.name: Adaptation text
sourceLanes.canEstablish: What reached the screen or an identified script state.

sourceLanes.name: Production testimony
sourceLanes.canEstablish: Intent, process, and retrospective explanation attributed to named makers.
sourceLanes.cannotEstablish: Screen fact that is absent from the released work.

sourceLanes.name: Licensed companions
sourceLanes.canEstablish: Versioned companion claims, maps, interface states, and editorial variants.

sourceLanes.name: Community reception
sourceLanes.canEstablish: Theory origin, transmission, terminology, consensus, and rebuttal history.

questionFrames.label: Identity or lineage
questionFrames.burden: Name the exact proposition, competing identities, continuity, and falsifying witness.

questionFrames.label: Chronology
questionFrames.burden: Separate event order, narration order, calendar conversion, and adaptation timing.

questionFrames.label: Geography or logistics
questionFrames.burden: Name the map edition, route assumptions, scale, season, force, and material constraint.

questionFrames.label: Magic or prophecy
questionFrames.burden: Separate observed event, character interpretation, symbolic reading, and causal mechanism.

questionFrames.label: Book and screen comparison
questionFrames.burden: Identify each continuity, witness state, scene or chapter locator, and the claimed delta.

questionFrames.label: Theory history
questionFrames.burden: Identify origin, earliest surviving statement, mutation path, cited evidence, and strongest rebuttal.
